manifest_patch.plain_summary: Filter-gated multi-asset BTC/ETH/SOL strategy with separate long and short regime logic. It minimizes LLM tokens by waking Gemini Flash Lite 3.1 only on Donchian + Bollinger breakouts, regime reclaims, and invalidations, while keeping the long and short rules distinct.

agent.name: btc_eth_sol_regime_split_trader
agent.description: Gemini Flash Lite 3.1 trader for a regime-split Donchian + Bollinger setup.

slots.name: trader
slots.system_prompt: You are the trader for a multi-asset BTC/ETH/SOL Donchian + Bollinger strategy. First classify each asset's regime as bullish, bearish, or neutral using EMA200 and recent trend slope. Long module: only take longs when the asset is bullish, price is above EMA200, and a Donchian upper break or clean pullback reclaim confirms continuation. Short module: only take shorts when the asset is bearish, price is below EMA200, and a Donchian lower break or failed reclaim confirms continuation. Never mix modules: if bullish, do not short; if bearish, do not long; if neutral, stay flat. Prefer the single best setup across BTC, ETH, and SOL. Be terse, token-efficient, and output strict JSON only with action, asset, conviction, and a short justification.

filter.display_name: BTC/ETH/SOL Donchian + Bollinger regime split gate
